common_mistakes.mistake: A hero leaves a TARGET before the two-second charge completes
common_mistakes.consequence: Only charge resets to zero; RESCUE stays latched. Losing blue TARGET also removes its bridge support and Pac finish-door effect unless another active pad supplies them. Attacks can recur after their one-time interruptions.
common_mistakes.recovery: If both heroes remain safe, reoccupy their TARGETs and hold for the full two seconds. A safe interrupted charge does not require repeating STOP, STEADY, and RESCUE.
